bindingRule: Create one new configuration for each baseline/candidate P1/P3 diagnostic repetition after its exact uninstrumented endpoint succeeds. Pin all scripts, original unchanged runner/oracle, actual original-format activated runtime configuration/grant, toolchain, archive/member inventory and three emitted modules. Declare stageTenant plus exact granted installed/evidence/host/scratch parents as moduleRoots; a loaded URL must be canonical, within a declared root and byte-identical to its selected module pin. Child commands enumerate exact node path and observed bare node alias if used; npm-node-script binds the actual toolchain npm CLI script path/digest and invokes it through the exact Node binary with observer flags. No ambient NODE_OPTIONS or PATH shim; do not instrument unlisted processes silently. New canonical /private/tmp diagnostic and runtime roots only, all absent before execution. No P2/P4/native repetition.
